title: Five Laredo teams open the high school football playoffs this week
excerpt: Five Laredo teams — LBJ, Nixon, Cigarroa, United and Alexander — open the UIL bi-district playoffs Thursday through Saturday.
content:
Five Laredo high school football teams open the UIL bi-district playoffs this week, with games Thursday through Saturday, according to Dave Campbell's Texas Football and MaxPreps schedules. The Laredo Morning Times published its first-round playoff preview on Tuesday, November 10.

Thursday, November 12, 7:00 p.m. — Laredo LBJ (7-3) at San Antonio Brennan (9-1), Farris Stadium, San Antonio.

Thursday, November 12, 7:00 p.m. — Laredo Nixon (5-5) at Smithson Valley (9-0), Ranger Stadium, Spring Branch.

Thursday, November 12, 7:00 p.m. — Laredo Cigarroa vs. Corpus Christi Ray.

Friday, November 13, 7:30 p.m. — San Antonio Harlan (8-2) at Laredo United (7-2), United ISD Student Activity Center.

Saturday, November 14, 2:00 p.m. — San Antonio Warren (6-4) at Laredo Alexander (6-4), United ISD Student Activity Center.

LBJ and United are in Class 6A Division I, Alexander is in Class 6A Division II, and Nixon is in Class 5A Division I. Cigarroa, which clinched a playoff berth last week for the first time in 20 years, opens against Ray.

Sources: Dave Campbell's Texas Football, November 7, 2026; MaxPreps; Laredo Morning Times, November 10, 2026.
